protocol.policy: model candidates only; no information probes; no LB-derived coefficients

selection_policy.cohort: Frozen cohort: A1_physical_equal, A2_spectral, A3_dawid_skene, and V2_model; each card and artifact hash predates its first upload. No candidate is grandfathered outside this cohort.
selection_policy.candidate_A: Lowest eligible public RMSE among the frozen model cohort using only the new _cgs artifacts; all earlier public scores are void for selection because column 2 was transport_gap.
selection_policy.candidate_B: Rebuild the deterministic 50% shrink companion from the _cgs A-rule winner; no target means, historical scores, or cell adjustments.
selection_policy.predicted_vs_actual_threshold: The former 1e-3 target-error rule is superseded: target labels are unavailable and probing is forbidden; local correctness/reproducibility invariants are required instead.

noise_estimate.per_cell_formula: SE_cell(MSE) approximately sd_cell/sqrt(0.30*n_cell); sd_cell is the standard deviation of per-tract squared-error contributions and is not observable without labels
noise_estimate.planning_assumption: independent approximately normal residuals; SE(RMSE) approximately RMSE/sqrt(2*n)
noise_estimate.historical_scale_candidate_note: P4 is an LB-calibrated historical benchmark used only to illustrate score sampling noise; it is not eligible for this protocol or a new model parameter
noise_estimate.pairwise_guard_rule: SE_public(candidate_1)+SE_public(candidate_2); a smaller public RMSE difference is a tie, not a selection reason

candidate_registrations.hypothesis: The v0 detail failed because its component levels were uncentred proxies whose uncentred correlation with the target was 0.1786 and whose region-mean-removed detail was anti-informative (unconstrained beta -0.218). v2 replaces each proxy with a mechanism estimated from the provided Overture counts themselves - route/named-road ratio, fixed building residual prior calibrated against the Overture building presence rate, and the organiser's facility/establishments halves with fixed presence priors - so the composite should track the same completeness mechanism the organiser scored, giving centred correlation above the 0.30 forecast assumption and a public RMSE below the 0.091440198 P4 benchmark.
